questions.question: The phenomenon of inducing an EMF in a circuit due to a change of magnetic flux linked with it is called:
questions.explanation: Correct Answer: (B) Electromagnetic induction. Discovered by Michael Faraday in 1831, a changing magnetic flux induces an electromotive force (EMF) in a closed conductor.

questions.question: Faraday's Law of Electromagnetic Induction states that the magnitude of induced EMF is proportional to:

options.B: Time rate of change of magnetic flux

questions.explanation: Correct Answer: (B) Time rate of change of magnetic flux. ε = -N (ΔΦ / Δt). The induced EMF depends on how fast magnetic flux changes, not its absolute value.

questions.question: The negative sign in Faraday's law ε = -N (ΔΦ / Δt) represents:
questions.explanation: Correct Answer: (B) Lenz's Law. Lenz's law dictates that the induced current always opposes the initial flux change that produces it, manifested as a minus sign.

questions.question: Lenz's Law is a direct consequence of the law of conservation of:
questions.explanation: Correct Answer: (B) Energy. Mechanical work done against the opposing induced magnetic field is converted into electrical energy. If it did not oppose, energy would be created from nothing, violating energy conservation.

questions.question: Motional EMF induced in a conductor of length L moving with velocity v perpendicular to a magnetic field B is:
questions.explanation: Correct Answer: (B) ε = -v B L. When a rod moves across magnetic field lines at velocity v, Lorentz force on charges inside creates a potential difference ε = -vBL sinθ.

questions.question: If a conductor moves parallel to a magnetic field (θ = 0°), the motional EMF induced across its ends is:
questions.explanation: Correct Answer: (B) Zero. ε = vBL sinθ = vBL sin 0° = 0 because no magnetic flux lines are cut.

questions.question: Mutual inductance M between two coils is defined by the relation ε_s = -M (ΔI_p / Δt). Its SI unit is:
questions.explanation: Correct Answer: (B) Henry (H) or V s A⁻¹. 1 Henry is the mutual inductance when a rate of change of 1 A/s in primary induces an EMF of 1 V in secondary.

questions.question: Self-induced EMF (back EMF) in a coil of self-inductance L carrying changing current I is given by:
questions.explanation: Correct Answer: (A) ε_L = -L (ΔI / Δt). Self-induction opposes any growth or decay of current in the coil itself, termed back EMF.

questions.question: The self-inductance L of a solenoid of length l, cross-sectional area A, with N total turns is:
questions.explanation: Correct Answer: (A) L = μ₀ N² A / l. Since Φ = B A = (μ₀ N I / l) A, total flux linkage NΦ = μ₀ N² I A / l, giving L = NΦ/I = μ₀ N² A / l.

questions.question: The energy U_m stored in the magnetic field of an inductor carrying current I is:
questions.explanation: Correct Answer: (A) U_m = 1/2 L I². Work done in establishing current against back EMF is stored in the magnetic field as U_m = (1/2) L I².

questions.question: The magnetic energy density (energy per unit volume) in a magnetic field B inside an inductor is:
questions.explanation: Correct Answer: (A) u_B = B² / (2μ₀). Analogous to electric energy density (1/2 ε₀ E²), magnetic energy density in free space is B² / (2μ₀).

questions.question: An AC generator converts mechanical energy into electrical energy based on:
questions.explanation: Correct Answer: (B) Faraday's law of electromagnetic induction. A coil rotating in a uniform magnetic field experiences changing flux, generating alternating sinusoidal EMF.

questions.question: The instantaneous EMF generated by an AC generator of N turns, area A rotating at angular frequency ω in field B is:

options.A: ε = N A B ω sin(ωt)
options.C: ε = N A B / ω sin(ωt)

questions.explanation: Correct Answer: (A) ε = N A B ω sin(ωt). Since Φ = BA cos(ωt), ε = -N dΦ/dt = NABω sin(ωt) = ε₀ sin(ωt), where ε₀ = NABω is peak EMF.

questions.question: If the rotational speed of an AC generator coil is doubled, its maximum output EMF ε₀ will:
questions.explanation: Correct Answer: (B) Double. Since peak EMF ε₀ = NABω = NAB(2πf), doubling rotational speed (or frequency f) directly doubles the peak EMF.

questions.question: In a DC generator, alternating current induced in the armature coil is converted to pulsating direct current using:
questions.explanation: Correct Answer: (B) Split-ring commutator. A split ring (commutator) reverses the connection to the external circuit every half-cycle, maintaining unidirectional DC output.

questions.question: In an electric motor, back EMF ε increases as the motor:
questions.explanation: Correct Answer: (B) Speeds up. By Faraday's law, back EMF is proportional to rotational speed. As speed rises, back EMF increases, reducing armature current I = (V - ε)/R.

questions.question: If an electric motor is suddenly jammed and cannot rotate, the armature current will:

options.B: Become very large and may burn the windings

questions.explanation: Correct Answer: (B) Become very large and may burn the windings. When stopped, back EMF ε = 0, so current surges to V/R. Since armature resistance R is tiny, huge current can overheat and burn the motor.

questions.question: A transformer operates on the principle of:
questions.explanation: Correct Answer: (B) Mutual induction between two coils. A transformer transfers electrical energy between primary and secondary circuits through mutual magnetic flux in a core.

questions.question: A transformer cannot work on steady Direct Current (DC) because:

options.B: Steady DC produces no time-varying magnetic flux (ΔΦ/Δt = 0)
options.C: Transformers have too much resistance for DC

questions.explanation: Correct Answer: (B) Steady DC produces no time-varying magnetic flux (ΔΦ/Δt = 0). Electromagnetic induction requires changing flux. Steady DC produces a constant field, so no EMF is induced in the secondary.

questions.question: In an ideal step-up transformer, which quantity increases in the secondary compared to the primary?
questions.explanation: Correct Answer: (A) Voltage. In a step-up transformer, N_s > N_p, so V_s > V_p. By energy conservation, current decreases proportionally (I_s < I_p).

questions.question: The turns ratio of a transformer is given by:

options.A: V_s / V_p = N_s / N_p = I_p / I_s

questions.explanation: Correct Answer: (A) V_s / V_p = N_s / N_p = I_p / I_s. In an ideal transformer, secondary-to-primary voltage ratio equals turns ratio and inverse of current ratio (P_in = P_out).

questions.question: Eddy currents induced in solid metallic transformer cores are minimized by:

options.B: Using a laminated core made of insulated thin sheets

questions.explanation: Correct Answer: (B) Using a laminated core made of insulated thin sheets. Laminations break the closed circular paths of eddy currents, significantly reducing I²R eddy current energy losses.

questions.question: Hysteresis loss in a transformer core is reduced by choosing core materials with:

options.A: Narrow hysteresis loop (e.g. soft silicon steel)

questions.explanation: Correct Answer: (A) Narrow hysteresis loop (e.g. soft silicon steel). The area of the hysteresis loop represents energy dissipated as heat per cycle of magnetization. Soft silicon steel has a very narrow loop.

questions.question: Electrical power is transmitted over long grid distances at very high voltages in order to:

options.B: Reduce current and minimize I²R power transmission losses
options.C: Increase the frequency of alternating current

questions.explanation: Correct Answer: (B) Reduce current and minimize I²R power transmission losses. For transmitting power P = VI, stepping up voltage V reduces current I proportionally, slashing Joule heating losses (P_loss = I²R_line).

questions.question: A step-down transformer has 1000 turns in primary and 100 turns in secondary. If 220 V AC is applied to primary, secondary voltage is:
questions.explanation: Correct Answer: (B) 22 V. V_s = V_p × (N_s / N_p) = 220 V × (100 / 1000) = 22 V.

questions.question: When a magnet is moved toward a closed conducting coil with its North pole facing the coil, the induced current produces a:

options.A: North pole to repel the approaching magnet
options.B: South pole to attract the approaching magnet

questions.explanation: Correct Answer: (A) North pole to repel the approaching magnet. By Lenz's Law, the induced current opposes the motion causing it, thus establishing a North pole facing the approaching North pole.

questions.question: When the magnetic flux linking a coil of 50 turns changes by 0.2 Wb in 0.1 s, the average induced EMF is:
The unit of self-inductance (Henry) is equivalent to:

options.A: V s A⁻¹ or Wb A⁻¹

questions.explanation: Correct Answer: (A) V s A⁻¹ or Wb A⁻¹. From L = ε / (dI/dt), units are V / (A/s) = V·s/A. Also from L = NΦ/I, units are Wb/A.

questions.question: Eddy currents are circulating currents induced in bulk metallic masses by changing magnetic fields. Which device uses eddy current damping?
questions.explanation: Correct Answer: (A) Deadbeat galvanometer. Eddy currents generated in the metallic coil frame produce opposing torque that rapidly damps coil oscillations to bring it smoothly to rest.

questions.question: Induction cooktops heat cooking vessels through:

options.B: High-frequency magnetic fields generating eddy currents and hysteresis heat in ferromagnetic cookware

questions.explanation: Correct Answer: (B) High-frequency magnetic fields generating eddy currents and hysteresis heat in ferromagnetic cookware. Rapidly alternating magnetic flux induces intense eddy currents in the iron pan base, cooking food cleanly and efficiently.

questions.question: If the primary of an ideal transformer draws 2 A at 220 V, and the secondary supplies 11 V, the secondary current is:
questions.explanation: Correct Answer: (A) 40 A. In an ideal transformer, P_in = P_out => V_p I_p = V_s I_s => 220 × 2 = 11 × I_s => I_s = 440 / 11 = 40 A.

questions.question: The efficiency η of a real transformer is given by:
questions.explanation: Correct Answer: (A) η = (Power Output / Power Input) × 100%. Commercial transformers achieve 95%–99% efficiency.

questions.question: Mutual inductance M between two closely coupled coils is related to their self-inductances L₁ and L₂ by:
questions.explanation: Correct Answer: (A) M = k √(L₁ L₂). Here k is the coupling coefficient (0 ≤ k ≤ 1); for complete flux linkage, k = 1 and M = √(L₁ L₂).

questions.question: In an AC generator, when the plane of the armature coil is perpendicular to the magnetic field lines:

options.A: Flux linked is maximum and induced EMF is zero
options.B: Flux linked is zero and induced EMF is maximum
options.C: Both flux and induced EMF are maximum
options.D: Both flux and induced EMF are zero

questions.explanation: Correct Answer: (A) Flux linked is maximum and induced EMF is zero. When the coil is perpendicular to field (θ = 0° with normal), Φ = BA (maximum), but rate of change dΦ/dt ∝ sin(0°) = 0, so induced EMF is zero.

questions.question: In an AC generator, when the plane of the coil is parallel to the magnetic field lines:

options.A: Flux linked is zero and induced EMF is maximum
options.B: Flux linked is maximum and induced EMF is zero
options.C: Both flux and induced EMF are zero

questions.explanation: Correct Answer: (A) Flux linked is zero and induced EMF is maximum. When the coil plane is parallel to field, the normal is perpendicular (θ = 90°), so flux Φ = 0, but dΦ/dt is maximum, giving peak induced EMF.
